rationale.com.siddumoni.fakecall.debug.DYNAMIC_REC: AndroidX Core AAR manifest compatibility declaration for RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED runtime receivers on Android before API 33. It is signature-protected. The debug application ID includes the .debug suffix; minSdk 35 means the legacy runtime fallback is unreachable, but the dependency manifest entry remains merged.
rationale.com.siddumoni.fakecall.DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_: AndroidX Core AAR manifest compatibility declaration for RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED runtime receivers on Android before API 33. It is signature-protected. minSdk 35 means the legacy runtime fallback is unreachable, but the dependency manifest entry remains merged.
rationale.android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS: Allows the user-approved scheduled simulated-call notification on Android 13+. Runtime permission is requested in context; if denied or later revoked, the app does not launch an Activity or silently downgrade the schedule.
rationale.android.permission.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM: Allows a user-selected exact simulated-call schedule only after checking canScheduleExactAlarms() and sending the user to Alarms & reminders special app access when needed. Approximate mode uses an inexact alarm and never requests this access.
rationale.android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETE: Restores pending future simulated-call alarms after a device restart through a non-exported receiver. Expired and interrupted records are closed.
rationale.android.permission.VIBRATE: Allows the call notification channel to vibrate and the volume shortcut to confirm with a short buzz. The user can disable vibration or change sound in Android notification-channel settings.
rationale.android.permission.USE_FULL_SCREEN_INTEN: Owner-approved opt-in. A full-screen intent is attached only after the user turns on Full-screen incoming call in the app and Android allows it. Off by default.
rationale.android.permission.WAKE_LOCK: Holds a proximity screen-off wake lock only while an answered call screen is visible with the speaker off, so the face cannot press buttons.
